info.value: 1.936 glAsnAvanuvamAM ca iti gaRasUtreRa ayaM DAtuH upasargasya anupasTitO vikalpena mittvaM prApnoti .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to bathe, to cleanse, to purify

info.value: snAtIti SOce snassnAyediti cecCantI kecana ' (Slo.11) - devaH .

examples: 'samudraM vA ete prasnAnti ye saMvatsaraM (saMvatsarasADyaM gavAmayanam) upayanti' (tARqyabrA॰5.8.5). prasnAnti apravagAhante.
'tIrTena yaTA samudraM nAyuH' (Sa॰brA॰12.2.1.1). prasnAyuriti snAterliNi rUpam. praviSeyurityarTaH.
'yo vA aplavaH samudraM prasnAti na sa tata udeti' (paYca0 brA0 4.5.17). prasnAti avagAhate praviSati.
'mA no devAnAM viSaH prasnAtIrivosrAH kfSaM na hAsuraDniyAH' (tE0 saM0 2.6.11.2). prasnAtIH trasnuvatIH prasnutAH.
'karasnO bAhU karmaRAM prasnAtArO' (ni0 6.17.1). prasnAtArO nirvartayitArAviti durgaH.
prasnAnyasminniti prasnaH. snAnIyaM bfhad BAjanam. GaYarTe kAviDAnaM sTAsnApAvyaDiniyuDyarTam iti snAteH kaH.
'apasnAta ivArizwaM praviveSa gfhottamam' (rA॰2.42.22). priyasya banDorniDane sati OrDvadehikIH kriyAH kartuM snAto'pasnAta ucyate.
'udvartanamapasnAnaM viRmUtre raktameva ca' (manu॰4.132). apasnAnaM snAnodakaM snAnaSizwaM jalam.
'anyasya cAvasnAtaM dUrataH parivarjayet' (BA0 anu0 104.59). avasnAtaM yatrAnyena pUrvaM snAtam.
'vizamityudakanAma. vizRAte rvipUrvasya snAteH SudDyarTasya' (ni0 12.26.1).
'vivAhe kftyAM yAM cakrurAsnAne tAM nidaDmasi' (aTarva0 18.2.65). AsnAnaM snAnArTakaM jalam.
'SabdabrahmaRi nizRAto na nizRAyAtpare yadi' (BA0 pu0 11.11.18). na nizRAyAt kOSalaM nApnuyAt.
'nizRAtopi ca vedAnte sADutvaM nEti durjanaH' (BA0 vi0 1.87). nizRAtaH kuSalaH.
'SabdabrahmaRi nizRAtaH paraM brahmADigacCati.' ukto'rTaH.
'tatra tatra ca nizRAtAnaDyakzAnkuSalAYSucIn' (yAjYa0 1.322). nizRAtAn ananyavyApArAn iti mitAkzarA.
'yaH kaScidarTo nizRAtaH svarucyA tu parasparam' (yAjYa0 2.84). nizRAta iyatA kAlenEtAvad deyamiyatI ca vfdDiH pratimAsaM deyetyevaM vyavasTitaH.
'nizRAtaSca samAgamopi vihitastvatpreyasaH kAntayA' (mAlatI0 10.24). nizRAtaH sAkalyena nirvfttaH.
'ArdraH praTasnurBuvanasya gopAH Sfta utsnAti janitA matInAm' (tE0 brA0 3.7.5.3). utsnAti jalAduttarati, nirgacCati.
'ta utsnAya rayimaBipra tasTuH' (f0 2.15.5). ukto'rTaH.
'sUtraM pratizRAtam' (pA0 8.3.90). SudDamityarTaH. sUtrAdanyatra pratisnAtamityeva. api susnAto BavAn. bAQaM pratisnAtosmi.
'gacCa mAgaDikAmAnayopasnAnena' (avi0 5).
